workflow: Magnetism is the force of attraction or repulsion between materials due to the alignment of the molecules in the material. All materials respond to the presence of a magnetic field, but the effect is much stronger in materials like iron, cobalt, and nickel which are strongly attracted to the magnetic field and can become magnetized themselves.
